name: particles
title: Particles
description: Specks of light drifting across a canvas that lean towards the cursor. Rests off screen and stills under reduced motion.

props.name: size
props.description: Radius of the smallest particle in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed in pixels per second. 0 holds the field still.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of the drift in degrees. 0 drifts right, 90 drifts down.

props.name: magnetism
props.description: How far particles lean towards the cursor, in pixels. 0 turns it off.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS color. Defaults to the foreground token.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
